tier2_candidates.headline: This dot-com survivor says AI build-out is more like 1997 than 1999 — and still urges investors to hold more cash
tier2_candidates.snippet: The riveting gains for microchip stocks have many analysts drawing parallels to 1999, just ahead of the dot-com crash, when the build-out of a key technology led to parabolic moves and frenzied speculation.

tier2_candidates.headline: Inflation jumps to 3-year high, CPI shows, and that’s not the end of it
tier2_candidates.snippet: The U.S. inflation rate leaped to a nearly three-year high of 3.8% in April because of higher gas prices — and the pain for consumers isn’t going away anytime soon.

tier2_candidates.headline: Meet the Nvidias of power — 5 stocks winning Big Tech’s $700 billion AI energy grab
tier2_candidates.snippet: Infrastructure giants such as GE Vernova and Bloom Energy are the new gatekeepers of the AI grid.

tier2_candidates.headline: I’m 68. Is it wise to invest my $500,000 retirement savings with a single investment firm?
tier2_candidates.snippet: The Securities Investor Protection Corporation provides coverage of up to $500,000 for stocks, bonds and mutual funds, including up to $250,000 in cash.

tier2_candidates.headline: The ‘godfather of crypto’ predicts $1 million bitcoin, but it’s going to fall first
tier2_candidates.snippet: Michael Terpin explained his theory of four-year cycles in the bitcoin price that bottom during midterm-election years. One more correction is coming before another bull market.
